Overview

Meknes is a city in Fès-Meknès with a population of 520,000. An imperial city with grand gates and historic monuments, offering a quieter alternative to nearby Fes. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
